description: This file is the server entry point for a Remix-based web application, responsible for handling HTTP requests, rendering the React app server-side, and managing server responses including handling bot user agents and CORS headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main entry point for handling incoming HTTP requests, setting CORS headers, and delegating to specific request handlers based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests identified as from bots, rendering React components to a stream and returning the HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, rendering React components to a stream and returning the HTML response.
